findings.claim: R41 asks for flow figures across the case's accounts 'after removing paired own-account transfers'. compute_case computes combined flows from each account's categorised lines with no own-account pairing: R8 is implemented nowhere in src (it is T34, which depends on T33). An inter-account transfer that neither the rule table nor the profile names is counted on both sides of the combined figures, inflating combined money in, which is the reply's 'counted twice' concern. The producer acknowledges this (disposition 'reproduced'). R41 can pass only after an owner scope decision or once T34 is delivered.
